answer: Spectral trust gates entry: every new identity must hold a decaying influence bond, and a spectral graph-cut runs each epoch to prune trust-leaking clusters. A farm forging N fakes spends N bonds plus N edge fees and a live chain for each, so the thousandth fake costs a thousand times the first and buys no extra reach, since influence follows real-user weight. No bulk discount: each edge is a live proof, not pooled. Detected clusters forfeit all bonds and face a 40-epoch ban. Like a dawn over a meadow where quartz marks the boundary, one honest edge outranks a thousand forged ones.
